title: Minimax Precision for Desired-Partner Contrasts under Preference-Weighted Pair Formation
banked_reason: D0.5 rates the sound all-regime Gibbs preferred-pair minimax frontier subfield below the field floor; not salvageable within scope. Yi citation instantiations verified after terminal-validity clarification.
gap_reasons: The delivered result is a matched all-regime order bound for the stated joint minimax object, with an explicit attaining procedure and a converse covering asymmetric weights and biased or randomized original-record estimators; no stale frontier overclaim remains. Novelty rests on collective bounded-Gibbs coverage, which the unrestricted-design results in [Kandiros–Harshaw–Sävje](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.04909v1) do not evaluate. The Gaussian marginalization, small-support bounds, Gamma identity and completion are supported by [Yi’s public theorem text](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.04079v1), while the manuscript supplies the additional parameter-uniform threshold and complementary cycle argument. The contribution remains specific to one public perfect matching, bounded product weights and balanced binary assignment, without a general characterization of optimal formation designs. The projected paper score is constrained by very loose precision constants, exponential sampling cost, and finite-risk illustrations confined to the smallest roster; the additional reported diagnostic batches also lack specified inputs or executable reproduction artifacts in the delivered note. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.8 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the all-weight, all-estimator order frontier for a public desired matching under bounded Gibbs formation, with an explicit attaining rule. The independent validity audit and final citation recheck cleared the Yi admissibility concern; remaining unused-assumption and related-work findings are nonfatal. The final novelty review rates the delivered package subfield (score ceiling 6.8), below the standing field floor; stopped before F1, so no Lean proof was produced.
tldr: Partners can change experimental outcomes, while deployment may specify different partners from those realized during an experiment. For the public desired-partner causal contrast under Gibbs formation with a public cap on pair-preference scores and exact group-arm balance, the joint minimax squared error satisfies \(R(G,\Lambda)\asymp[1+\min\{\Lambda,G\}]^{-1}\) uniformly over every roster size, cap, legal deterministic weight matrix, and bounded Borel estimator of the full original record. Symmetric desired-edge boosting with total empty-cell sample means attains the rate, while a collective all-weight coverage bound and frozen-table Bayes argument give the converse. Exact finite optimality of symmetric weights is not claimed.
gap: Joint design-and-estimator minimax theory for fixed observed networks is available \cite{KandirosHarshawSavje2026}. The unresolved object is the public desired-pair contrast under a bounded product-weight formation law and exact group-arm balance, with precision certified uniformly in \((G,\Lambda)\).
fill: The joint frontier is sought in the fixed-table experiment over every legal deterministic weight array and every original-record rule. A collective formation or subset-information converse must certify a concrete attaining design in every preference regime and decide or correct the candidate phase diagram. Counting constants that are valid only for each fixed \(\Lambda\) do not meet this requirement.
